The projection-matrix regex omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 48 of the 64 matrices required by Required result 1 are cast to bfloat16; the 16 `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` tensors are left as float32. Consistent with that bug, the script asserts a bfloat16 count of 48 instead of the 64 demanded by the Required checks, so the check would not fail loudly on the wrong result.
